name: Misa Online
summary:
From the Age of Legends, remnants known as Portal Stones covered in mysterious, undeciphered symbols—are now falling across the world. But these are no mere ancient relics…

Each impact tears open gateways to unknown realms. Through these portals, creatures emerge bringing not only themselves, but the laws, darkness, and chaos of their worlds. As time passes, the land begins to change, balance is shattered, and the world is dragged into an irreversible war.

Survival is no longer a choice it is a necessity.

Every new portal brings a new threat, a new challenge, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Gather your strength, shape your destiny, and forge your legend against the rising darkness.
